hero.subtitle: Rugged gateways, sensors and edge devices with a cloud platform for dashboards, alerts, anomaly detection, remote control and automated compliance reports.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Water networks, solar plants and construction sites are spread across vast areas, often with patchy connectivity. Many are still checked by site visits, so leaks, faults and quality problems are found late and at high cost.
points: Water lost before it reaches the customer
Quality issues found after concrete has cured

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: With most urban water expected to come from desalination by 2030 and renewables growing fast, every litre and kilowatt matters. Live data turns scattered assets into a network you can see and control.

capabilities.title: Rugged gateways and sensors
capabilities.body: Modbus and serial interfaces; 4G, WiFi, LAN and LoRa connectivity.

capabilities.title: Offline buffering
capabilities.body: Edge devices store readings when the link drops and forward them later.

capabilities.title: Secure transport
capabilities.body: TLS-encrypted MQTT from device to platform.

capabilities.title: Anomaly detection and remote control
capabilities.body: Spot unusual behaviour and act on assets remotely.

capabilities.title: Automated compliance reports
capabilities.body: Scheduled reports for regulators and management.

applications.title: Smart water and non-revenue water
applications.body: Pressure, flow and leak detection across distribution networks.

applications.title: Solar PV monitoring and control
applications.body: String-level performance, inverter health and remote control.

applications.title: Smart concrete
applications.body: Temperature and strength monitoring during curing on construction and giga-project sites.

applications.title: Air quality and environmental monitoring
applications.body: Dust, emissions and noise data for sites and cities.

vision2030.body: Live monitoring supports the National Water Strategy, the Saudi Green Initiative and the growth of renewable energy.
programs: National Industrial Development and Logistics Program

deployment.note: Platform in in-Kingdom cloud or on-premise; edge devices keep working through connectivity loss.

seo.title: Industrial IoT & Smart Infrastructure | Saudi Arabia
seo.description: Rugged sensors, gateways and a live platform for smart water, solar PV, smart concrete and environmental monitoring across Saudi Arabia.
